summary: Quantumoney web app (quantumoney.app / quantumoneyar.app) built on Internet Computer Protocol. Fixing structural provider issues and profile synchronization between the two domains.
architectural_notes: Provider hierarchy: AuthProvider → LanguageProvider → Router → App. No duplicate or nested providers allowed.
Both quantumoney.app and quantumoneyar.app must use identical Logic, Ledger, and Governance canister IDs in production.
UserID must be derived from the Internet Identity Principal — no auto-creation of profiles if backend profile does not exist.
known_issues: useLanguage error: LanguageProvider not wrapping all routes, causing context errors on Legal/Contact/Tokenomics pages.
Profile divergence between quantumoney.app and quantumoneyar.app — likely using different canisters or mock backend on one domain.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix LanguageProvider not wrapping all routes — ensure single global LanguageProvider wrapping AuthProvider → LanguageProvider → Router → App, no duplicates

Fix profile divergence between quantumoney.app and quantumoneyar.app — both must use same Logic/Ledger/Governance canisters, same backend (no mock), same UserID from Principal, no auto-profile creation, production environment only

Restructure the global provider hierarchy so that a single LanguageProvider wraps the entire application. The required nesting order must be: AuthProvider (InternetIdentityProvider) → LanguageProvider → Router → App. Remove any duplicate or partial LanguageProvider instances found elsewhere in the component tree. Every route — including Legal, Contact, Tokenomics, Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, and all other pages — must be inside this single LanguageProvider. No route or page component may call useLanguage outside of this provider scope.

Audit and enforce that all canister actor calls throughout the frontend use the hardcoded production canister IDs for Logic, Ledger, and Governance canisters. Remove any environment-switching logic that could route requests to local, dev, or mock canisters. Both quantumoney.app and quantumoneyar.app must always connect to the same production ICP mainnet canisters.

Remove any automatic profile creation logic from the frontend. If a user's Principal does not have an existing profile in the backend, the application must display a clear error or 'Profile not found' state instead of silently creating a new profile. The UserID used throughout the app must be derived solely from the authenticated Internet Identity Principal — no synthetic IDs or fallback IDs should be generated.
